t: A small ESP32-S3 board with a bright color screen and battery charging.
steps: Buy the board from the LilyGO store or the LilyGO shop on Tindie.
Pick the touch version for finger control or the soldered version for breadboards.
Install the free Arduino IDE or PlatformIO in VS Code and add the ESP32 board package.
Follow the setup steps in the official T-Display S3 repo.
Select the LilyGO T-Display S3 display setup for the TFT_eSPI library.
Run a simple example from the repo to fill the screen with color.
Hold BOOT and tap RST in case an upload fails.
Set GPIO15 high in your code to keep the screen on battery power.
meta: Open Board. From $8.89. A few stores.
